channel.title: GitHub C Languages Daily Trending
channel.description: Daily Trending of C Languages in GitHub

item.title: JustVugg / colibri
item.description: A hierarchical inference engine for frontier MoE models: hot experts on the GPU (CUDA, Vulkan), warm ones in RAM, cold ones streamed from NVMe. Written in C, runs on the hardware you already own.

item.title: openssl / openssl
item.description: General purpose TLS and crypto library

item.title: FareedKhan-dev / kimi-k3-in-c
item.description: A 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running inference on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM. Portable C99: no BLAS, no framework, no GPU.

item.title: curl / curl
item.description: A command line tool and library for transferring data with URL syntax, supporting DICT, FILE, FTP, FTPS, GOPHER, GOPHERS, HTTP, HTTPS, IMAP, IMAPS, LDAP, LDAPS, MQTT, MQTTS, POP3, POP3S, RTSP, SCP, SFTP, SMTP, SMTPS, TELNET, TFTP, WS and WSS. libcurl offers a myriad of powerful features

item.title: madler / zlib
item.description: A massively spiffy yet delicately unobtrusive compression library.

item.title: espressif / esp-idf
item.description: Espressif IoT Development Framework. Official development framework for Espressif SoCs.
